# Study Hub

> Desktop app (Windows, macOS) for university students that use Canvas. Free. Independent student project, not affiliated with any university or Instructure.

What it does:
- Every Canvas deadline, quiz and exam on one screen, with countdowns and weights.
- Finds exam dates written in course announcements and shows the source sentence.
- Grade calculator: weighted mark so far and the average still needed for each grade band.
- AI review with the student's own AI provider (OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic, local Ollama): practice questions, flashcards, revision plans. It does not write graded work.
- Exports deadlines to phone calendars; reminders keep working with the window closed.

Data stays on the student's device. The developer runs no server that receives course data.

## Download (always the latest version)
- Windows: https://github.com/17373624812qq-code/Study-Hub-releases/releases/latest/download/StudyHub-Windows-Setup.exe
- macOS, Apple chip: https://github.com/17373624812qq-code/Study-Hub-releases/releases/latest/download/StudyHub-Mac-AppleSilicon.dmg
- macOS, Intel: https://github.com/17373624812qq-code/Study-Hub-releases/releases/latest/download/StudyHub-Mac-Intel.dmg
- All versions: https://github.com/17373624812qq-code/Study-Hub-releases/releases

The installers are not code-signed yet. Windows: "More info" → "Run anyway". macOS: right-click the app → Open the first time.
